Block: AI_1

This routine handles the inputs connected to the IC200ALG262 analogue input module in PLC slot 3. Channel %AI0001 to %AI0008.

76 RungsCalls: CalcVa1, Ai_AL_1
Rung 1
This routine handles the inputs connected to the IC200ALG262 analogue input module in PLC slot 3. Channel %AI0001 to %AI0008.
Rung 2
Standard psaudo code:

Move Analogue input value to VALUE_IN
Call CALCVAL				//Converts input value.
_VAL = VALUE_IN
Call AI_ALARM				//Calculates low and high alarm and fault

if LOALARM then latch _ALL bit until system reset
_ALLI = (_ALL and not _INH)
if HIALARM then latch _ALH bit until system reset
_ALHI = (_ALH and not _INH)
If (Any_actions and _ALHI) then latch _FRUP until system reset
_SC  = HIFAULT
_OC = LOFAULT


Psaudo code for digital detectors on analogue inputs:
(No scaling of input value, and only high alarm.)

Set special alarm limits
Move Analogue input value to VALUE_IN
Call AI_ALARM				//Calculates low and high alarm and fault

_ALL = 0
_ALLI = 0
if HIALARM then latch _ALH bit until system reset
_ALHI = (_ALH and not _INH)
If (Any_actions and _ALHI) then latch _FRUP until system reset
_SC  = HIFAULT
_OC = LOFAULT

This routine calls the voting and C&E routines for the various fireareas on the Rig.
This routine also calculates internal variables used in the logic such as Any_Action, System_Reset, System_Reset_Delay and Acknowledge bits.

The System_Reset bit will be high when the reset pushbutton is pressed OR when reset from HMI.
HMI reset bit is reset after 5 sec.

Block: CE_LOG

This block do all Cause & Effect logic for this Fire & Gas system.

27 Rungs
Rung 1
This block do all Cause & Effect logic for this Fire & Gas system.
Setting OUTPUT's done in blocks called: Shutdown, Protect, Indicat, Loc_Al and FLT1.
Rung 2
History on changes after 23.april-03:
- 12.juni-03:  Timer for start of pump B (second and third time) changed from 30 to 60 sec. Done on 3 timers.
- 12.juni-03: New input (6401-ESDV-001) to also trip PumpShutdown (%Q08), Oil Booster Pumps (%Q03) and Water Booster Pumps (%Q04).
Rung 3
Logic for Shutdown.
Rung 4
Rung 5
Rung 6
Logic for Fire Protection.
Rung 7
Start of Pump A logic. 
Start signal on as long as input active. BUT:
- The pump will be active for 60 minutes and then reset fire detectors and foam release buttons.
- Will reset if system reset pushed "Reset Fire&Gas" (and inputs normal)   OR 
- "Stop Foam" button pushed!
Rung 8
Rung 9
Rung 10
Start of Pump B logic.
If pump A start init. activated in 30 seconds without getting deluge released signal (pressure transmitter), then:
- puls (2 sec.) to start pump B is activated. If still no released signal within 60 sec. then:
- puls (2 sec.) to start pump B is activated. If still no released signal within 60 sec. then:
- puls (2 sec.) to start pump B is activated. If still no released signal within 60 sec. then:
- set bit to display alarm in panel: "Deluge failed to release.".
Rung 11
Rung 12
Rung 13
Rung 14
Rung 15
Rung 16
Rung 17
Rung 18
Rung 19
Stop of pump B logic.
When fire detectors return to normal OR when stop foam is pusshed, stop puls (2 sec.) is trigged.

Logic for Indication on panel (not operator panel).
